C1.rationale: Constraints are proportionate: the loud ones guard an automation contract or an irreversible action and state why (the conventional-commit mandate is justified by release-please automation; sync-ids is gated on --dry-run; the blueprint disabled-task table gives a reason per row). Softer prescriptions about authoring structure and table style are imperative rather than delegated to judgment, which keeps it off 4, but nothing reads as a fence around an untrusted model.

C2.rationale: A memory file with no invocable interface: no arguments, flags, or parameters to name or enumerate. The dimension does not apply.

C3.rationale: The entry point genuinely delegates: ~38 rule files, docs/pi-export.md, adapters/README.md, docs/blueprint/README.md and docs/PLUGIN-MAP.md are all referenced by name rather than inlined, which is real multi-file disclosure. It stops short of exemplary because the entry point is not lean — full release-please/marketplace JSON literals and two skill frontmatter templates are transcribed inline instead of living in the files that own them.

C4.rationale: The file repeatedly names the owning rule and then copies from it anyway: the Agentic Optimization section points at the rule and restates its 'Fail fast'/'Machine-readable' principles; the Skill Granularity table and its bun example duplicate .claude/rules/skill-development.md:251 near-verbatim; the release-please JSON duplicates .claude/rules/release-please.md:53-60. It also repeats itself internally (the same mkdir step and frontmatter block appear in both authoring sections), and the two orphan table rows stranded after '## Conventions' are visible drift from exactly this pattern.

C5.rationale: Applying the per-section test, most of the budget fails it. Project Structure, Plugin Organization and the naming Conventions document structure a reader sees from the repo; Quick Start, Creating User-Invocable Skills, Plugin Lifecycle (with inline JSON scaffolding) and Development Workflow are step-by-step procedures that only matter once someone asks to author a plugin or skill. A generic 'research, plan, write, test, PR' loop is the obvious. What lifts it above 1 is a real gotcha core (the blueprint constrained-dogfooding rules, the pi skill-listing budget caveat, the enablement-drift CI gate) plus heavy name-referencing of supporting files — but gotchas are the minority of the tokens, not the majority anchor 3 asks for.

C6.rationale: Deterministic work is largely delegated to named executables and pointed at clearly: the enablement-drift and pi-tier checks are cited as scripts that fail CI, pi/tiers.yaml is labelled the source of truth, and the export flows are given as just recipes rather than described. It does not reach 4 because the single largest mechanical procedure in the file, creating a plugin, is prose plus hand-transcribed JSON where the scaffold command it already mentions or a schema could state it exactly.

top_finding: Promote the authoring procedures (Quick Start, Creating User-Invocable Skills, Plugin Lifecycle, Development Workflow) into one plugin-authoring skill referenced by name, leaving CLAUDE.md as repo blurb plus rules index plus gotchas.
counter_finding: The Blueprint constrained-dogfooding section earns its always-loaded tokens: which tasks are deliberately disabled and why, the --dry-run precondition, and the consumer-only autonomy-level-3 boundary are non-derivable facts that must hold before any turn touches docs/blueprint/.

leakage.note: This repo auto-injects CLAUDE.md and roughly a dozen .claude/rules/*.md into every agent context, so the unit under judgment was already present in my context before I opened it; I re-read /home/user/claude-plugins/CLAUDE.md from disk and every quote is taken from that read. Files consulted for C4 duplication (.claude/rules/agentic-optimization.md, skill-development.md, release-please.md) were opened deliberately, not injected. The house standards listed above were noticed but excluded per the rubric's exclusion list; where they overlapped a scored dimension I scored only the published property (leanness for C5, single-sourcing for C4), never adherence to the house convention itself.
